listing.name: International Superstar Soccer 2000 — ISS2000 (djultra64)
listing.summary: An early native port of the European International Superstar Soccer 2000 release with portable Windows and Linux setup packages.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Europe English/German revision 0 ROM, SHA-256 6ce6739b8ead149857c9442178a1ecd9b7f6d15b93a582c7208ca85d493817bf.

steps.title: Start the Windows x64 package
steps.instruction: Extract ISS2000-Windows-0.7.1.zip into a writable folder and run iss2000.exe. Use a Vulkan-capable GPU and select your supported original when asked.

steps.title: Start the Linux x64 package
steps.instruction: Extract ISS2000-Linux-0.7.1.zip into a writable folder and run ./launch.sh there. It loads the adjacent lib/ files and appends diagnostics to data/runtime.log. Use Vulkan, glibc 2.38 and libstdc++ with GLIBCXX 3.4.32 or newer. Select your supported original when asked.

warnings: Upstream’s Windows smoke test reached the title screen, but the normal window-close request did not finish. Use the upstream setup route. Portcove has not observed normal exit, gameplay or save recovery.

references.title: Keep the portable data folder
references.instruction: The upstream picker accepts ZIP, Z64, N64 or V64 containing the matching original. Keep your original separately. The player stores its private ROM copy, settings and Controller Pak saves under data/ beside the executable. Back up that folder before replacing the package.
